notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused a sound effect to sound when a bullet made contact with Volt.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that summoned spirits during conversation in the third stage "Forest Noir".
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some ghosts to move while posing.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Once you have purchased an event, you can watch it as many times as you want.
[*] Press the button again to start the event without losing money.
[/list]
